main_text.p: spondet Hebraeo לשׁ. Drusius putat legendum per ר. Vide ejus notas ad hunc locum.
Syriac. Claves, Graec. κλεῖδες, Matth. 16. 19. Lucae 11. 52.
קלד Chald. Urere, comburere, adurere, ustulare, affare, torrefacere. Aphel אקלי Vilipendere, Deut. 27. 16. Syr. Vilipendentes, contemnentes alter alterum ad Galat. 5. 26.
קליא Ch. Prefter, Serpens ignitus. Plur. קלין, Numer. 21. 7. Cantic. 1. 9.
קלנא, קלן Chal. Levitas, vilitas, ignominia, probrum, opprobrium: Cum ab initio קלן Jesa. 22. 18.
מקלה Ch. Uftio, combuftio, aduftio: ספר מקלה על רישיהון Pulverem aduftionis super capita sua, id est, cinerem, Thren. 2. 10. Regia, Pulverem ignominiae.

קוליא Ch. Species oleris seu herbae agrestis dulcis, ut Kimchius explicat: Juxta Baal Aruch, species herbae, cujus combuftae pulvis saponi accommodus, Ezec. 27. 17. Vide R. D. Kimchium; Respondet Hebr. פנג, quod diversimode explicatur.
קלח Pah. Ch. Effundere: Fut. ואילן ראנפי ברא יקלח פירוי Et arbor agri effundet fructus suos, Levit. 26. 20. in Targ. Jon. id est dejiciet, perdet.
קלוח Ch. Fluxus, effluxus, emanatio, eruptio. Pl. emph. קלוחיא Jobi 24. 8.
קלחא Ch. Caulis herbae. Plur. תלתא קלחין Tres caules, Num. 19. 18. in Targ. Jonath.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac, Chaldee and Greek forms are transcribed as best read from the scan; several vowel points and small marks are uncertain and may differ from the printed original. The final word-line "קלט" stands alone at the lower right, possibly a catchword or signature.
